subject: general
question: The number of Rajya Sabha members to be elected from each State of India has been fixed by the _______ Schedule of the Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fourth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fourth Schedule of the Indian Constitution deals with the allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha to the states and union territories.
 
• Rajya Sabha, also known as the Council of States, is the upper house of India's Parliament.
 
• The Fourth Schedule specifies the number of Rajya Sabha members to be elected from each state and union territory.
 
• This allocation is based on the population of each state and union territory.
 
• The total number of members in the Rajya Sabha is capped at 250, including 12 members nominated by the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajya Sabha:**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution.
 
• One-third of its members retire every two years, ensuring continuity.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by the elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies and Electoral college for Union Territories.
 
• The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Amendments:**
 
 
• The Fourth Schedule has been amended multiple times to reflect changes in the allocation of seats based on census data.
 
• Such amendments ensure that representation in the Rajya Sabha remains proportionate to the population of states and union territories.
 
 
 
• **Representation:**
 
 
• States with larger populations have more seats in the Rajya Sabha compared to smaller states.
 
• Union territories with smaller populations have fewer seats, with some having only one seat.
 
 
 
• **Nominated Members:**
 
 
• In addition to elected members, the President of India nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha.
 
• These nominated members are chosen for their contributions to art, literature, science, and social services.
